notes.title: Development Update & New Timeline
notes.notes:
✨ Little Update


I recently started a new job, which is why I’ve been a bit quiet.

This means the release of Super Tennis Breakout will be slightly delayed. I used to work on it full-time, but now I’ll continue part-time. Right now, I’m aiming for a December release if everything goes well.



🎾 The demo is currently offline, but I’ll be updating it soon with fresh improvements and then re-releasing it!



Thank you all so much for your support and patience ❤️
